== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[We're Doomed (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|We're Doomed]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-were-doomed/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_We_re_Doomed.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8a40732644966e805179e2d9f04ec25f029b0267b90f00076dc38d768c52ada1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
